description: Which model the AI Stupid Level Smart Router would send a prompt to, and why: the routing strategy, the chosen model and provider with its benchmark score and estimated cost, and the fallback chain. Nothing is sent to a model and nothing is counted. Needs a router key (ASL_ROUTER_KEY).

mode.description: Routing mode (default auto = the strategy saved in the account): auto-best (highest combined score), auto-coding, auto-reasoning, auto-tooling (top model on that benchmark), auto-task (reads the prompt and picks the benchmark), auto-value, auto-value-coding, auto-value-reasoning, auto-value-tooling (most points per measured dollar among models within 5 points of the best), auto-fastest-quality, auto-consistent (fastest or steadiest near-top model), auto-fastest, auto-cheapest (no quality bar).

pin_model.description: Pin a specific model id (for example gpt-6-sol) instead of a routing mode.

prompt.description: The prompt to route (the decision can depend on it, for example with auto-task).

sandbox.description: Sandbox: run the real routing as if the account had a key for every provider and return a mock answer. Nothing is called, spent or counted.

name: preview_route
title: Preview Smart Router choice
